title: Persist Control-Plane Repo Assistant Chats Across Redeploys
specification:
# PRD: Persist Control-Plane Repo Assistant Chats Across Redeploys

Priority: high

## Problem
Repo assistant conversations and chat IDs are lost whenever the hosted control-plane is redeployed because the control-plane state store runs in memory on DYNO hosts and repo-assistant chat executions do not persist or resume Codex conversation IDs.

## Goal
Make repo-assistant conversations survive control-plane restarts and redeploys, with stable chat IDs and recoverable history for each repo.

## Requirements
- Persist control-plane conversation state outside process memory for hosted DYNO deployments.
- Ensure repo assistant conversation lists and message history reload correctly after server restart or redeploy.
- Preserve stable control-plane conversation IDs across restarts.
- Evaluate and implement durable storage of underlying Codex conversation/session IDs when available, or explicitly document that only message history is resumed.
- Keep current read-only repo assistant behavior and existing conversation-history prompt continuity.
- Handle missing or stale persisted conversation/session references safely without breaking chat UX.

## Acceptance Criteria
- After a redeploy, previously visible repo-assistant conversations for a repo still appear in the control-plane UI.
- Managers can open an existing conversation after redeploy and continue it without creating a new chat unless they choose to.
- Conversation message order, timestamps, and PRD proposal attachments remain intact after restart.
- If underlying Codex session resume is supported, follow-up messages reuse the stored conversation/session ID; if not supported, the system clearly falls back to history-based continuity.
- Automated tests cover hosted persistence and restart recovery behavior.

## Verification
- Add unit tests for control-plane store persistence and reload of conversations.
- Add smoke coverage that simulates server restart/redeploy and verifies conversations remain available.
- Verify follow-up chat requests after restart continue the same conversation record and do not lose prior history.
